02060 Vashtiy {vash-tee'}

起源於波斯語; 陰性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Vashti 10; 10

瓦實提 = "漂亮的"
1) 亞哈隨魯王的王后, 因不遵行王的命令而被王廢掉

02060 Vashtiy {vash-tee'}

of Persian origin;; n pr f

AV - Vashti 10; 10

Vashti = "beautiful"
1) the queen, wife of Ahasuerus, whom he divorced for disobeying his orders
